output.reason: The release note on its own [ev-5536699d3447] is only a title, but the linked PR description [ev-ceaa0860b105] fills the gaps. It names the subject: the source hydrator path in the application controller, with the single changed file controller/state.go [ev-106aa32af5c1]. It states the change: the hydrator no longer fetches the Kubernetes server version or API versions, because it doesn't use them. It also gives who is exposed and what happens: with a sharded controller, hydration on one shard could fail when it had no access to a destination cluster handled by another shard. This release fixes that, so it is a bug fix and operators need do nothing.
